# HeatPumpAtlasUSA

> U.S. heat pump installation prices, operating costs, rebate requirements and ZIP-based estimates.

HeatPumpAtlasUSA compares the cost of heating your home with a heat pump and your current fuel. Read the methods and sources behind the numbers, or use the calculator on the website.

- [Calculator and savings estimates](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/calculator/)
- [Methodology and sources](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/methodology/)
- [HTML page sitemap](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/sitemap-index.xml)
- [Corrections and contact information](https://heatpumpatlasusa.com/about/#contact)

Each Markdown copy below is generated directly from the page's published HTML content. Front matter links to the canonical page. Use the website for interactive estimates and forms.
